blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Adrian Nocum and Rain or Shine are set for another quest for a PBA championship that has eluded them so many times in the last two seasons. But Nocum is hopeful that the time for a breakthrough finally comes in the Governors’ Cup playoffs. “Sana eto naman. Mina-manifest namin na sana umabot sa Finals (We’re hoping that this will be our time. We’re manifesting it that we’ll reach the Finals),” Nocum said ahead of the Elasto Painters’ best-of-five quarterfinal series with the Converge FiberXers that starts on Tuesday.
